import unittest
from scheduler import ready


def task(task_id, dependencies=(), writes=()):
    return {"id": task_id, "dependencies": list(dependencies), "writes": list(writes)}


class SchedulerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_one_ready(self):
        tasks = [{"id": "a", "dependencies": [], "writes": ["a.py"]}]
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), [], 1), ["a"])

    def test_total_capacity_excludes_active_workers(self):
        tasks = [task("running"), task("a"), task("b")]
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), [tasks[0]], 2), ["a"])
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), [tasks[0]], 1), [])
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), [tasks[0]], 0), [])

    def test_dependencies_require_completion_before_this_wave(self):
        tasks = [task("a"), task("b", ["a"]), task("c", ["running"]),
                 task("done"), task("d", ["done"])]
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, {"done"}, [task("running")], 5),
                         ["a", "d"])

    def test_active_write_conflict_uses_canonical_paths(self):
        tasks = [task("same", writes=["SRC/./A\\file.py"]),
                 task("child", writes=["src/a/sub/file.py"]),
                 task("parent", writes=["src"]),
                 task("sibling", writes=["src/ab/file.py"])]
        active = [task("running", writes=["src/a"])]
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), active, 3), ["sibling"])

    def test_selected_writes_exclude_later_overlaps(self):
        tasks = [task("first", writes=["src/a"]),
                 task("child", writes=["src/a/file.py"]),
                 task("equal", writes=["SRC\\A"]),
                 task("sibling", writes=["src/ab"]),
                 task("ancestor", writes=["src"])]
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), [], 5), ["first", "sibling"])

    def test_read_only_tasks_consume_capacity_without_conflict(self):
        tasks = [task("read_one"), task("write", writes=["src/a"]),
                 task("read_two")]
        active = [task("running", writes=["src/a"])]
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), active, 3),
                         ["read_one", "read_two"])

    def test_inputs_are_not_mutated(self):
        tasks = [task("a", writes=["SRC\\a"]), task("b", ["a"])]
        active = [task("running", writes=["other"])]
        completed = {"done"}
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, completed, active, 3), ["a"])
        self.assertEqual(tasks, [task("a", writes=["SRC\\a"]),
                                 task("b", ["a"])])
        self.assertEqual(active, [task("running", writes=["other"])])
        self.assertEqual(completed, {"done"})

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

            {"id": "child", "dependencies": ["parent"], "writes": []},
            {"id": "done", "dependencies": [], "writes": []},
        ]
        active = [{"id": "already-running", "dependencies": [], "writes": []}]
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, {"done"}, active, 4), ["parent"])

    def test_skips_completed_and_active_tasks(self):
        tasks = [
            {"id": "done", "dependencies": [], "writes": []},
            {"id": "running", "dependencies": [], "writes": []},
            {"id": "next", "dependencies": [], "writes": []},
        ]
        active = [{"id": "running", "dependencies": [], "writes": []}]
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, {"done"}, active, 3), ["next"])

        tasks = [
            {"id": "active-conflict", "dependencies": [], "writes": ["src"]},
            {"id": "first", "dependencies": [], "writes": ["lib/core"]},
            {"id": "selected-conflict", "dependencies": [], "writes": ["lib"]},
            {"id": "independent", "dependencies": [], "writes": ["docs"]},
        ]
        active = [{"id": "writer", "dependencies": [], "writes": ["src/a.py"]}]
        self.assertEqual(
            ready(tasks, set(), active, 4), ["first", "independent"]
        )

    def test_scope_comparison_uses_canonical_paths_and_boundaries(self):
        tasks = [
            {"id": "same", "dependencies": [], "writes": ["SRC\\a\\child\\.."]},
            {"id": "sibling_prefix", "dependencies": [], "writes": ["src/ab"]},
        ]
        active = [{"id": "writer", "dependencies": [], "writes": ["src/a"]}]
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), active, 3), ["sibling_prefix"])

    def test_read_only_tasks_do_not_conflict_or_mutate_inputs(self):
        tasks = [
            {"id": "reader-one", "dependencies": [], "writes": []},
            {"id": "reader-two", "dependencies": [], "writes": []},
        ]
        active = [{"id": "writer", "dependencies": [], "writes": ["src"]}]
        original_tasks = [task.copy() for task in tasks]
        original_active = [task.copy() for task in active]

        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), active, 3), ["reader-one", "reader-two"])
        self.assertEqual(tasks, original_tasks)
        self.assertEqual(active, original_active)

        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), [], 1), ["a"])

        tasks = [task("a"), task("b"), task("c")]
        active = [task("running")]
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), active, 2), ["a"])
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), active, 1), [])
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), active, 0), [])

    def test_only_completed_dependencies_unlock_tasks(self):
        tasks = [task("done"), task("running"), task("first"),
                 task("needs_running", ["running"]), task("needs_first", ["first"]),
                 task("needs_done", ["done"])]
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, {"done"}, [task("running")], 4),
                         ["first", "needs_done"])

    def test_active_and_earlier_selected_writes_reserve_scopes(self):
        tasks = [task("active", writes=["other"]),
                 task("blocked_by_active", writes=["SRC\\Pkg\\module.py"]),
                 task("selected", writes=["src/lib/../a"]),
                 task("blocked_by_selected", writes=["src/a/child.py"]),
                 task("sibling", writes=["src/ab"]),
                 task("same_as_active", writes=["src/pkg"])]
        active = [task("active", writes=["src/pkg"])]
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), active, 5), ["selected", "sibling"])

    def test_read_only_tasks_consume_capacity_without_conflict(self):
        tasks = [task("reader_one"), task("writer", writes=["src"]),
                 task("reader_two"), task("conflict", writes=["src/file.py"])]
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), [task("active", writes=["src"])], 4),
                         ["reader_one", "reader_two"])
        self.assertEqual(ready([task("writer", writes=["src"])], set(),
                               [task("reader")], 2), ["writer"])

    def test_canonical_root_directory_scopes(self):
        tasks = [task("relative_child", writes=["src/file.py"]),
                 task("absolute_child", writes=["/src/file.py"])]
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), [task("root", writes=["src/.."])], 3),
                         ["absolute_child"])
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), [task("root", writes=["/"])], 3),
                         ["relative_child"])
        self.assertEqual(ready([task("absolute_root", writes=["/"])], set(),
                               [task("relative_root", writes=["."])], 2),
                         ["absolute_root"])
        self.assertEqual(ready([task("parent", writes=["../src"])], set(),
                               [task("relative_root", writes=["."])], 2),
                         ["parent"])

    def test_inputs_are_not_modified(self):
        tasks = [task("pending", ["done"], ["SRC\\a\\..\\b"])]
        active = [task("running", writes=["elsewhere"])]
        completed = {"done"}
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, completed, active, 2), ["pending"])
        self.assertEqual(tasks, [task("pending", ["done"], ["SRC\\a\\..\\b"])])
        self.assertEqual(active, [task("running", writes=["elsewhere"])])
        self.assertEqual(completed, {"done"})

if __name__ == "__main__":

        before = copy.deepcopy(data)
        out = migrate(data)
        self.assertEqual(out, {"schema_version": 2,
            "workers": {"labels": ["a"]}, "other": [2],
            "execution": {"max_workers": 0, "enabled": False,
                          "extra": {"items": [1]}}})
        out["workers"]["labels"].append("b")
        out["execution"]["extra"]["items"].append(3)
        out["other"].append(4)
        self.assertEqual(data, before)

        self.assertEqual(migrate({}), {"schema_version": 2,
            "execution": {"max_workers": 2, "enabled": True}})
        self.assertEqual(migrate({"workers": {"enabled": False}})["execution"],
                         {"max_workers": 2, "enabled": False})
        self.assertEqual(migrate({"execution": {"max_workers": None}})["execution"],
                         {"max_workers": None, "enabled": True})
        for data in ({}, {"workers": {}}, {"workers": {"enabled": False}},
                     {"execution": {"max_workers": None}},
                     {"workers": {"custom": [1]}, "schema_version": 2}):
            with self.subTest(data=data):
                out = migrate(data)
                self.assertEqual(migrate(out), out)
                self.assertEqual(out["schema_version"], 2)
                self.assertIn("max_workers", out["execution"])
                self.assertIn("enabled", out["execution"])

        for data in ({"workers": None}, {"workers": []},

                migrate(data)

    def test_unknown_alias_is_preserved(self):
        shared = {"limit": 4, "enabled": False, "nested": [1]}
        data = {"workers": shared, "execution": shared, "backup": shared}
        out = migrate(data)
        self.assertEqual(out["backup"], shared)
        self.assertEqual(out["execution"], {
            "limit": 4, "enabled": False, "nested": [1], "max_workers": 4})
        self.assertEqual(out["workers"], {"nested": [1]})
        self.assertEqual(shared, {"limit": 4, "enabled": False, "nested": [1]})

    return {"id": ident, "writes": list(writes), "dependencies": list(deps)}

class Checks(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_waves(self):
        tasks = [task("db", ["db"]), task("api", ["api"], ["db"]),
                 task("ui", ["ui"], ["api"])]
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), [], 3), ["db"])
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, {"db"}, [], 3), ["api"])
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, {"db", "api"}, [], 3), ["ui"])

    def test_active_and_capacity(self):
        a, b = task("a", ["src/a"]), task("b", ["src/b"])
        self.assertEqual(ready([a, b], set(), [a], 2), ["b"])
        for limit in (-1, 0, 1):
            self.assertEqual(ready([a, b], set(), [a], limit), [])
        self.assertEqual(ready([task("c", deps=["a"])], set(), [a], 2), [])

    def test_selected_overlap_both_directions_and_boundary(self):
        tasks = [task("a", ["src/a"]), task("child", ["src/a/file.py"]),
                 task("parent", ["src"]), task("ab", ["src/ab"])]
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), [], 4), ["a", "ab"])
        self.assertEqual(ready(list(reversed(tasks)), set(), [], 4), ["ab", "child"])

    def test_helper_normalization(self):
        running = [task("busy", ["SRC/./A"])]
        tasks = [task("same", ["src/a/"]), task("child", ["src\\a\\file.py"]),
                 task("other", ["src/x/../ab"])]
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), running, 4), ["other"])

    def test_readers_and_preservation(self):
        running = [task("busy", ["src"])]
        tasks = [task("read"), task("write", ["src/a"]), task("else", ["lib"])]
        before = copy.deepcopy((tasks, running))
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), running, 2), ["read"])
        self.assertEqual(ready(tasks, set(), running, 3), ["read", "else"])
        self.assertEqual((tasks, running), before)

import csv
import io

def records_to_csv(records, fields):
    buffer = io.StringIO(newline="")
    writer = csv.DictWriter(buffer, fieldnames=fields, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(records)
    return buffer.getvalue()

from csv_utils import records_to_csv

def export(records, fields):
    if (not isinstance(fields, list) or not fields
            or any(not isinstance(k, str) or not k for k in fields)
            or len(set(fields)) != len(fields)):
